question: The Gupta Empire is often referred to as the "Golden Age of India." In which field of knowledge did significant advances occur during this period?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Science, Art, Literature**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Gupta Dynasty:

 
• The founder of the Gupta dynasty was Sri Gupta. 
 
• He was succeeded by Ghatotkacha. These two were called Maharajas.
